skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — combine my GIMP-edited image frames into a smooth video with transitions —...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Video Editing with GIMP — Turn GIMP Frames into Video"
- Upload GIMP-edited image frames or video clips (MP4, MOV, PNG, AVI up to 500MB)
- Describe your desired edit; AI automatically assembles and renders video with transitions
- All editing and rendering happens remotely—no software to install
- Simple session setup with free token support; manage credits and exports
- Ideal for graphic designers and digital artists wanting to turn GIMP artwork into polished videos without complex tools
